triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: lands in area:ux · domain:ui · Bug · priority:p2 · `pm:queue` · size M; rationale: the six console draft-then-publish callers and `@objectstack/client`'s `publishItem` still publish without the `draftVersion` pin that #36350 added, so another person's unreviewed draft can still be published from those paths. That is the same harm as #36350 on narrower paths, so the filed p2 stays.

Reader: zone o5-U (repo:objectstack#5), since seat 6 has clocked out. The client change touches `packages/client`, which the claim names as part of the file surface.

Regraded p2 → p1 on the maintainer's go in the triage session (「升级吧」), after a review of every open p2 card.

File surface: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioSaveBar.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DraftConflictDialog.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/detailSaveAtOnce.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordTabsConfigSave.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectExtensionArrangementSave.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts` (the card's `views/layout/` path moved to `layout/`), any further unpinned caller the claim-time grep finds (named in the PR), `packages/client/src/index.ts` (`meta.publishItem` option bag) with its tests, new test files named for this card, one `.changeset/37440-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT (dispatch-gates --tier: no path-derived mandate)`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening: `@objectstack/client` `meta.publishItem` accepts `draftVersion` and `parentVersion` beside `message` and `packageId`)
Metadata-protocol: none (the publish door's `draftVersion` pin is already on main from PR #37387; this card only makes callers send it)
Responsibility: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioSaveBar.tsx:324,399`, `metadata-admin/detailSaveAtOnce.ts:78`, `recordTabsConfigSave.ts:166`, `objectExtensionArrangementSave.ts:161` (objectstack-ai/objectstack) publish after their own draft write without the `draftVersion` that write returned, and `packages/client/src/index.ts:2729` `publishItem` sends only `message` | none: #37387 pinned four other callers (`runtime-metadata-persistence.ts:565,654`, `DraftConflictDialog.tsx:412` partly) | every Studio, design-mode and metadata-admin user whose save can publish a draft someone else wrote in between
Prior rulings read: #36350 ruling 7168616260 (A1, the pin and its four callers), ruling 7058616478 on #35955 (never publish an unreviewed draft on someone else's behalf); no ADR in `docs/adr/**` names these callers; this card follows them and changes no ruled behaviour
Premise: holds (origin/main 1af67b26cd: the five sites above call `publish(type, name, scope)` without `draftVersion`; `git grep draftVersion` under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views` hits only `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx`, `DraftConflictDialog.tsx`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`; `designModeMenuSave.ts` pins the published row it composed from and is re-checked by the dev for the draft pin; `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:655` `publishDraft('flow', …)` is re-checked as a possible unlisted caller)
Pre-claim lane: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell/**`), `packages/client` rides as the client half the card names
Pre-claim deps: none named; #36350 / PR #37387 merged
Serial constraints cleared: overlap-check runs before the first push; `studioSaveBar.tsx` sits under seat 5's `ux-37424` file roots (`views/studio-design/**`), so the dev reads open PRs on that path (seat 5's in-hand #37454 / #37520) before pushing and queues behind any textual conflict

Plan: the dev reproduces one caller (interleaved draft write, then the unpinned publish goes live) before code, then pins every caller to its own draft receipt, one pin plus a CONTROL per caller in that caller's existing harness. Nit N6 (DraftConflictDialog reload keeps the old token) rides when that file is touched. The PR carries `Fixes #37440`, and its `Clause-②: yes` declaration owes the seat's TIER_DEFAULT review before landing.
